image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a baked meatloaf in a metal baking pan. The meatloaf has been sliced, revealing a dense, textured interior with visible flecks of ingredients (possibly corn or carrots). The exterior is browned with a glossy, reddish-brown glaze on top. In the foreground, out of focus, there appears to be a side dish of yellow vegetables (likely corn or potatoes) and a serving utensil (spatula/knife) partially obscuring the view.
